name: Hellschreiber
description: Feld Hell — Rudolf Hell's 1929 fuzzy mode: text transmitted as literal pixels, column by column at 245 half-pixels/second, printed on a scrolling paper strip and decoded by eye. No bit decisions anywhere, so weak signals print faint and fuzzy instead of garbled. Classic double-line asynchronous display, shaped keying, self-test loopback.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
